featured_reviews.name: Amit Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text: Very kind and cooperative Owners from the same Maharashtrian family.  A well-managed gym, with no monkey-business, unlike others in the area.  Spacious and clean with adequate range of equipment.  The Owners exercise good control over the Trainers to ensure no misbehaviour with ladies.  My wife and I switched gyms to join Growth Fitness as soon as Sandesh Sagvekar left his service in another gym in the area and decided to start Growth Fitness a little over a year ago.  Music is played at soft volume so that it does not damage auditory nerves.  The toilets are clean and kept dry.  The gym tends to get a little hot in summer months, owing to the tin roof.  A trainer who had once misbehaved with a young lady member was immediately reined in by the Owners to ensure decorum, which has definitely not been the experience at other gyms in the Kandarpada area of Dahisar West.  This is a GOOD gym that is unpretentious and has very good management.  My wife and I have been happy members here, after having experienced other gyms in the area that care "two hoots" for members and redressal of the complaints from members.  Rules of the gym are uniformly applied to all members, unlike the selective application of gym rules at the whims of managers and Trainers at other gyms in Kandarpada.  It is a "No Nonsense" gym.  Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: I have been working out in Growth fitness since its inception and it has been just been upgrading itself in terms of ambience and equipments. The best part is they just to help you with workout but also organise events like treks and outdoor sports so you get to socialise with other gym members and also workout better. I would strongly recommend this gym for someone whose into some serious yet fun workouts.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience at Growth Fitness hasn’t been great. The trainer doesn’t give enough attention to the clients and often has an attitude, especially when repeatedly asked to turn on the AC or address any concerns. The gym is usually overcrowded, making it hard to get a good workout unless you visit during non-peak hours. If you go in the afternoon, be prepared to bring your own towel since only one AC is working, and it’s not sufficient for proper cooling. Go here only if you have no better options or can avoid the busy times.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Borkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been working out here since 2+ years now.

What's good:

Amazing equipments. Can't go wrong with these. Since Jerai is also an equipment manufacturing company, you can rest assured that any equipment if malfunctioned will be fixed in 15-20 minutes.

Great trainers. Trainers here are well regulated by the Management and they do not slack around but rather help you with the posture, weight, spotting, etc. Trainers here also do not encourage you to buy protein from them which is often a scam most trainers try to do in other gyms.

Fitness Tests.
When you join the gym, you must do a fitness test within a week of training which calculates various key aspects of your body including your body fat percentage, your water weight, etc. According to these results, you are given a plan to achieve your goals. There is no single "Vanilla plan" that is provided to new comers but one specifically designed for you.

Motivating atmosphere.
The price range might seem a little steep but for a yearly membership it is amazing. It also keeps out people who aren't serious. The people I have met so far have been very encouraging, down to earth and motivating.

Hygienic.
Everything is cleaned, every 1 hour or so. Including toilets, gym floors, equipments, etc. There is always a cleaning guy around ready to help clean around.
